dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special mechanisms?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Special mechanisms? Hahaha, that's a good one. Does it look like I'm in the business of making fancy contraptions?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Sure, I might once have worked at the Fontaine Research Institute, but that was a lifetime ago. Now it's all I can do to mend these little trinkets and make a few toys for the children.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Have you visited the Institute, by the by? The Fonta they make is the bomb, but it always seems to sell out right after lunchtime...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fonta? It's usually on sale around the clock...

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oho, yes, yes, my memory must be playing up — how could Fonta ever sell out?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Anyway, if there's nothing else, I've got some toys to make. Feel free to take a look around.
